urgent_ahead.detail: Occupied urgent and bulk queues, followed by both urgent and bulk pushes. Independent exact output check puts all three urgent frames before one bulk frame. Synthetic fixtures; claims limited to the imported running functions/model and stated premises.

cut_bytes.detail: Two ten-byte bulk frames, a twelve-byte burst; theorem bounds bytes of the actual cut. Synthetic fixtures; claims limited to the imported running functions/model and stated premises.

push_capped.detail: A nonempty mixed-lane push is admitted under 64 bytes, and the law fixes whatever admission returns: the lanes with both pushes, within the cap (not a value compared with itself). Negative control at cap 20 rejects it. Synthetic fixtures; claims limited to the imported running functions/model and stated premises.

write_first.detail: Two queued writes and two frames: the initial write-preferred turn selects Alice and switches preference to events. This first-turn law does not claim permanent write priority.

admit_bounded.detail: A second distinct peer address is actually admitted; derive both total-socket and per-address bounds. Synthetic fixtures; claims limited to the imported running functions/model and stated premises.

conn_bounded.detail: Construct reachable connection by open then authorized nonempty want, not an assumed Reachable premise; apply bounds. Synthetic fixtures; claims limited to the imported running functions/model and stated premises.

conn_state_bounded.detail: Same actual open/want history yields all five collection/snapshot bounds. Synthetic fixtures; claims limited to the imported running functions/model and stated premises.

hold_bounded.detail: Receive a nonempty have naming the fixture message at a receiver missing it; construct initial bounded-state premise. Synthetic fixtures; claims limited to the imported running functions/model and stated premises.

serveOwed_budget.detail: Nonempty stored shown message served from wanted queue under 1024-byte budget; Network.servesHead establishes actual output. Synthetic fixtures; claims limited to the imported running functions/model and stated premises.

honest_no_drop.detail: An actual tick at 90001 ms drops the connection; construct Call.tick and prove drop before applying the reason theorem. Synthetic fixtures; claims limited to the imported running functions/model and stated premises.

asks_expire.detail: An actual outstanding message ask expires at 20001 ms. Separate example proves the id was in asked before expiration. Synthetic fixtures; claims limited to the imported running functions/model and stated premises.

closure_capped.detail: Windowed round starts with one actual stored leaf in its frontier and takes a visit; prove initial pending/visited budget. Synthetic fixtures; claims limited to the imported running functions/model and stated premises.

closure_complete_under_cap.detail: Nonempty singleton closure of an actual stored message, roundFloor=100; construct Whole, uniqueness, empty visited, seed subset, fuel and capacity premises. Leaf has no requirements; multi-edge closure still needs additional fixtures. Synthetic fixtures; claims limited to the imported running functions/model and stated premises.

full_round_stateless.detail: Serve a stored queued message in full-round mode with concrete gone/sent lists; prove roundFloor premise. Synthetic fixtures; claims limited to the imported running functions/model and stated premises.

frames_kept.detail: A five-byte payload has only two bytes received after its length header; prove nonempty partial frame retained, then apply bounds. Synthetic fixtures; claims limited to the imported running functions/model and stated premises.

buffer_bounded.detail: The same nonempty partial frame occurs in an actual keeps history; apply buffer_bounded to its membership. Synthetic fixtures; claims limited to the imported running functions/model and stated premises.

frames_tooBig.detail: Decode a concrete length header of 1048577 and prove it exceeds the 1 MiB cap; entire frame input rejected. Synthetic fixtures; claims limited to the imported running functions/model and stated premises.

opening_honest.detail: Two nonempty snapshots [1,2] and [2,3], all-range query, injectively encoded identifiers and identity hash; generated claim is honest. Synthetic fixtures; claims limited to the imported running functions/model and stated premises.

exchange_complete.detail: Two nonempty overlapping snapshots [1,2] and [2,3]; prove sortedness, naming, honest opening, fuel and collision-freedom. sendsMissing demonstrates actual item 1 transfer. Uses identity hash to inhabit Sound, not a SHA-256 claim. Synthetic fixtures; claims limited to the imported running functions/model and stated premises.

exchange_log.detail: Same nonempty finite round; prove leaf-capacity and depth premises for two answers. Identity hash witnesses collision-freedom; not a SHA-256 claim. Synthetic fixtures; claims limited to the imported running functions/model and stated premises.

exchange_ids_stable.detail: Nonempty ids claim [2,3] answered by [1,2]; compare positive depths 1 and 5. Synthetic fixtures; claims limited to the imported running functions/model and stated premises.

exchange_stable.detail: Nonempty fingerprint round; prove sortedness, leaf-size and depth premises and compare depths 2 and 5. Synthetic fixtures; claims limited to the imported running functions/model and stated premises.

lane_control.detail: A wanted message id produces a real one-id control op; prove request count fits urgent threshold. Synthetic fixtures; claims limited to the imported running functions/model and stated premises.

hot_ids.detail: A node actually records the chat op at time 100; prove time 200 is inside hot interval and derive hot membership. Synthetic fixtures; claims limited to the imported running functions/model and stated premises.

boot_cached.detail: Boot index from the nonempty held store that contains the chat message. Synthetic fixtures; claims limited to the imported running functions/model and stated premises.

close_gone.detail: Closing hook returns the actual stored local secret id; prove stored lookup and local scope before applying close_gone. Held-store erasure, not physical disk deletion. Synthetic fixtures; claims limited to the imported running functions/model and stated premises.

purge_named.detail: Actual stored local secret is named in nonempty purge list; prove locality and storage, then derive absence and no index membership. Held-model purge only. Synthetic fixtures; claims limited to the imported running functions/model and stated premises.
